name: App Store Connect
description: App Store Connect API for apps, versions and localized metadata, builds, TestFlight groups and testers, customer reviews, provisioning, team access, sales/finance reports, and analytics reports. Requests are signed automatically with the Issuer ID, Key ID, and .p8 API private key from App Store Connect.

credential_fields.name: issuer_id
credential_fields.label: Issuer ID
credential_fields.description: Issuer ID shown on App Store Connect > Users and Access > Integrations.

credential_fields.name: key_id
credential_fields.label: Key ID
credential_fields.description: ID of the App Store Connect API key.

credential_fields.name: private_key
credential_fields.label: API Private Key (.p8)
credential_fields.description: Paste the full contents of the AuthKey_<KEY_ID>.p8 file, including BEGIN/END PRIVATE KEY lines. Multiline, escaped-newline, CRLF, and flattened PEM text are normalized before signing.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List apps visible to the API key. Filter by bundle ID, name, SKU, or platform and include related resources.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Get one app by App Store Connect resource ID.

tools.name: update_app
tools.description: Update writable app-level declarations such as third-party content rights.

tools.name: list_territories
tools.description: List App Store territories and their currencies.

tools.name: list_app_versions
tools.description: List App Store versions for one app, optionally filtered by platform or App Store state.

tools.name: get_app_version
tools.description: Get one App Store version and optionally include its build, localizations, review detail, or submission.

tools.name: create_app_version
tools.description: Create a new App Store version for an app. The runner builds Apple's JSON:API envelope from these arguments.

tools.name: update_app_version
tools.description: Update an App Store version's release settings or metadata.

tools.name: delete_app_version
tools.description: Delete an editable App Store version.

tools.name: request_version_release
tools.description: Request manual release of a version currently in Pending Developer Release.

tools.name: list_version_localizations
tools.description: List localized metadata for an App Store version.

tools.name: get_version_localization
tools.description: Get one App Store version localization.

tools.name: create_version_localization
tools.description: Create localized App Store metadata for a version.

tools.name: update_version_localization
tools.description: Update localized App Store metadata.

tools.name: delete_version_localization
tools.description: Delete one version localization.

tools.name: list_screenshot_sets
tools.description: List screenshot sets for one App Store version localization.

tools.name: create_screenshot_set
tools.description: Create a screenshot set for one localization and Apple display type.

tools.name: list_screenshots
tools.description: List screenshots in an App Store screenshot set.

tools.name: reserve_screenshot
tools.description: Reserve an App Store screenshot upload and return Apple's upload operations.

tools.name: commit_screenshot
tools.description: Commit an App Store screenshot after completing all upload operations.

tools.name: delete_screenshot
tools.description: Delete one App Store screenshot.

tools.name: list_preview_sets
tools.description: List app preview sets for one App Store version localization.

tools.name: create_preview_set
tools.description: Create an app preview set for one localization and Apple preview type.

tools.name: list_previews
tools.description: List app previews in one preview set.

tools.name: reserve_preview
tools.description: Reserve an App Store app-preview upload and return Apple's upload operations.

tools.name: commit_preview
tools.description: Commit an App Store app preview after completing all upload operations.

tools.name: delete_preview
tools.description: Delete one App Store app preview.

tools.name: get_version_review_detail
tools.description: Get review contact, notes, and demo-account details for an App Store version.

tools.name: create_version_review_detail
tools.description: Create App Review contact, notes, and optional demo-account details.

tools.name: update_version_review_detail
tools.description: Update App Review contact, notes, and optional demo-account details.

tools.name: list_review_attachments
tools.description: List attachments supplied to App Review.

tools.name: reserve_review_attachment
tools.description: Reserve an App Review attachment upload and return Apple's upload operations.

tools.name: commit_review_attachment
tools.description: Commit an App Review attachment after completing all upload operations.

tools.name: delete_review_attachment
tools.description: Delete one App Review attachment.

tools.name: list_app_infos
tools.description: List editable and live App Info resources for an app.

tools.name: update_app_info_categories
tools.description: Set primary and optional secondary App Store categories.

tools.name: list_app_info_localizations
tools.description: List localized app-level name, subtitle, and privacy URLs.

tools.name: create_app_info_localization
tools.description: Create localized app-level name, subtitle, and privacy URLs.

tools.name: update_app_info_localization
tools.description: Update localized app-level name, subtitle, and privacy URLs.

tools.name: get_app_age_rating_declaration
tools.description: Get the age-rating declaration for one App Info resource.

tools.name: update_age_rating_declaration
tools.description: Update Apple age-rating declarations. body must be an App Store Connect JSON:API document.

tools.name: get_app_price_schedule
tools.description: Read the app's current App Store price schedule.

tools.name: list_app_schedule_manual_prices
tools.description: List manually selected prices in an app price schedule with their price points and territories.

include.description: Use appPricePoint,territory to verify the selected customer price.

fields_app_price_points.description: Sparse fields for included price points, such as customerPrice.

fields_app_prices.description: Sparse fields for manual prices, such as appPricePoint,territory,startDate,endDate.

fields_territories.description: Sparse fields for included territories, such as currency.

tools.name: list_app_price_points
tools.description: List selectable App Store price points for an app, optionally in one base territory.

tools.name: create_app_price_schedule
tools.description: Create or replace an app price schedule using an AppPriceScheduleCreateRequest JSON:API document.

tools.name: get_app_availability
tools.description: Read the app's App Availability v2 resource and optionally include territory settings.

tools.name: list_app_availability_territories
tools.description: List every territory setting for one App Availability v2 resource.

tools.name: create_app_availability
tools.description: Create App Availability v2 using an AppAvailabilityV2CreateRequest JSON:API document.

tools.name: update_territory_availability
tools.description: Update one App Availability territory using a TerritoryAvailabilityUpdateRequest JSON:API document.

tools.name: list_builds
tools.description: List processed builds. Filter by app, version, processing state, platform, or expired status.

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: Get one build and optionally include its app, prerelease version, beta groups, or beta review submission.

tools.name: expire_build
tools.description: Expire a TestFlight build so testers can no longer install it.

tools.name: set_app_version_build
tools.description: Attach a processed build to an App Store version.

tools.name: add_builds_to_beta_group
tools.description: Add one or more processed builds to a TestFlight beta group.

tools.name: list_review_submissions
tools.description: List review submissions for an app, including provider state and related review items when requested.

submission_fields.description: Sparse fields for reviewSubmissions, such as platform,submittedDate,state,items,appStoreVersionForReview.

item_fields.description: Sparse fields for reviewSubmissionItems, such as state,appStoreVersion.

version_fields.description: Sparse fields for included appStoreVersions, such as versionString,appStoreState,build.

tools.name: get_review_submission
tools.description: Get one review submission and optionally include its items and App Store version.

tools.name: list_review_submission_items
tools.description: List the items in a review submission, including each item's state and related App Store version.

tools.name: update_review_submission_item
tools.description: Resolve or remove an existing App Store review submission item before resubmission.

tools.name: create_review_submission
tools.description: Create a review submission for an app.

tools.name: create_review_submission_item
tools.description: Add an App Store version to a review submission.

tools.name: submit_review_submission
tools.description: Submit a prepared review submission to App Review.

tools.name: list_beta_groups
tools.description: List TestFlight beta groups, optionally filtered by app, name, internal status, or public-link status.

tools.name: get_beta_group
tools.description: Get one TestFlight beta group.

tools.name: create_beta_group
tools.description: Create a TestFlight beta group for an app.

tools.name: update_beta_group
tools.description: Update a TestFlight beta group's name, public link, limits, or feedback setting.

tools.name: delete_beta_group
tools.description: Delete a TestFlight beta group.

tools.name: list_beta_testers
tools.description: List TestFlight beta testers, optionally filtered by email, app, group, or build.

tools.name: get_beta_tester
tools.description: Get one TestFlight beta tester.

tools.name: create_beta_tester
tools.description: Invite a TestFlight beta tester and optionally assign beta groups or builds in the same request.

tools.name: add_beta_testers_to_beta_group
tools.description: Add one or more existing TestFlight beta testers to a beta group.

body.description: JSON:API beta tester linkage array body.

tools.name: delete_beta_tester
tools.description: Delete a TestFlight beta tester and remove access to all apps.

tools.name: list_customer_reviews
tools.description: List App Store customer reviews for an app, filterable by territory, rating, and whether a published developer response exists.

include.description: Use publishedResponse or territory to include related resources.

tools.name: get_customer_review
tools.description: Get one App Store customer review.

tools.name: create_review_response
tools.description: Respond to an App Store customer review.

tools.name: delete_review_response
tools.description: Delete a response to a customer review.

tools.name: list_bundle_ids
tools.description: List registered bundle IDs for provisioning.

tools.name: get_bundle_id
tools.description: Get one registered bundle ID.

tools.name: register_bundle_id
tools.description: Register a new explicit or wildcard bundle ID.

tools.name: update_bundle_id
tools.description: Rename a registered bundle ID.

tools.name: delete_bundle_id
tools.description: Delete a registered bundle ID when Apple permits it.

tools.name: list_bundle_id_capabilities
tools.description: List capabilities currently enabled for a registered bundle ID.

fields[bundleIdCapabilities].description: Comma-separated capability fields, such as capabilityType,settings.

tools.name: enable_bundle_id_capability
tools.description: Enable a capability for a registered bundle ID.

tools.name: update_bundle_id_capability
tools.description: Update the settings for an enabled bundle ID capability.

tools.name: disable_bundle_id_capability
tools.description: Disable one explicitly selected bundle ID capability.

tools.name: list_certificates
tools.description: List development and distribution certificates.

tools.name: create_certificate
tools.description: Create a signing certificate from a PEM-encoded certificate signing request.

certificateType.description: For example IOS_DISTRIBUTION, DEVELOPMENT, or MAC_APP_DISTRIBUTION.

tools.name: revoke_certificate
tools.description: Revoke a signing certificate.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List registered test devices.

tools.name: register_device
tools.description: Register a device for development or testing.

tools.name: update_device
tools.description: Rename or enable/disable a registered device.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: List provisioning profiles and optionally include bundle ID, certificates, and devices.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get a provisioning profile. profileContent in the response is base64-encoded profile data.

tools.name: create_profile
tools.description: Create a provisioning profile from a bundle ID, certificate IDs, and optional device IDs.

tools.name: delete_profile
tools.description: Delete a provisioning profile.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List App Store Connect team users and their roles/app visibility.

tools.name: list_user_invitations
tools.description: List pending or accepted App Store Connect user invitations.

tools.name: invite_user
tools.description: Invite a user to App Store Connect with roles and optional visible apps.

tools.name: delete_user_invitation
tools.description: Cancel a pending App Store Connect user invitation.

tools.name: download_sales_report
tools.description: Download a gzip-compressed sales and trends report. The response is returned as a binary envelope.

tools.name: download_finance_report
tools.description: Download a gzip-compressed financial report for a vendor, region, and fiscal period.

tools.name: list_analytics_report_requests
tools.description: List analytics report requests for an app.

tools.name: create_analytics_report_request
tools.description: Request ongoing or one-time analytics reports for an app.

tools.name: list_analytics_reports
tools.description: List generated analytics reports under a report request.

tools.name: list_analytics_report_instances
tools.description: List report instances for an analytics report and date range.

tools.name: list_analytics_report_segments
tools.description: List downloadable segments for an analytics report instance. Each segment includes a download URL.
